readout.title: How coordination slowed (the four mechanisms of the Waltzman paper)
readout.summary: Country One, Country Two, and Country Three raised concerns about sensor coverage, legal responsibility, and staffing, while community and technical groups raised other local issues through separate channels. The partnership authorized and deployed the warning system, but recurring concerns, conditional support, agenda churn, and extended reviews slowed coordination; the system was later suspended and then resumed, while concerns were raised and reopened again.
